DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)

The MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement are highly specific for PML, while the normal CBC rules out many infectious or hematologic causes. To identify the underlying cause, which is often an immunocompromised state, can you tell me if you are currently taking any immunosuppressive medications or if you have a history of HIV?
